steps.u: Add a high-contrast mode toggle to the kiosk app, persisted across restarts. It's a Qt/QML app.

steps.r:
pragma Singleton
QtObject { property color bg: '#ffffff'; property color fg: '#1a1a1a'; property color accent: '#2a6fdb' }

i.old_string: QtObject { property color bg: '#ffffff'; property color fg: '#1a1a1a'; property color accent: '#2a6fdb' }

i.content: Settings { id: settings; property bool highContrast: false }

i.new_string: Switch { text: qsTr('High contrast'); checked: Theme.highContrast; onToggled: settings.highContrast = checked }

steps.a: The toggle changes the three theme colours through one property and QML Settings stores it between runs. I haven't run it on the kiosk hardware, only the smoke test.

reference.summary: Added a persisted high-contrast mode to the Qt QML kiosk app: the theme singleton switches its colours from one setting, a switch on the settings page toggles it, and QML Settings keeps it across restarts. Only the UI smoke test was run, not the kiosk hardware.
facts: theme colours switch on a highContrast property
